findings.summary: Removed an unmatched closing parenthesis from the command procedure and added an extracted dynamic-SQL delimiter regression. This is static validation and does not claim SQL Server compilation or execution.
Replaced JSON_VALUE for all six create/update summary and wording reads with OPENJSON nvarchar(max) extraction and retained the 8000 UTF-16-unit boundary.
Non-string command types, unsupported lone-surrogate text, and malformed bracketed verification URLs now return typed Living Resume validation errors, including through the owner API.

Role and credential mutations lock and require the owner-scoped matching subtype and one affected row. Accomplishment mutations revalidate the locked owner experience parent and its private, unpublished, history-free entity before writing a receipt.

Accomplishment update/remove now discovers its candidate parent without retaining a child lock, locks and validates the parent first, then locks and revalidates the exact child, owner, parent, and expected version.
Changed the proposed rollback ledger deletion to the repository-recognized equivalent T-SQL form while preserving the exact migration predicate and transaction.
